args.title: Invalidate existing bearer tokens when a password is reset
args.body:
File: src/api/auth.ts

Bearer tokens are stateless JWTs verified only by signature and expiry (requireAuth), so a token issued before a password reset keeps working until it naturally expires. Add a per-user "tokens valid since" timestamp (updated in setPassword/consumeResetToken) and check the JWT's issued-at claim against it in requireAuth, rejecting any token issued before the last password change.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

requireAuth only verifies a JWT's signature and expiry (src/api/auth.ts); there is no per-user "valid since" check, so a bearer token issued before a password reset stays usable until its own expiry. Fixing this means recording when a user's password last changed and rejecting tokens issued before that time.
